::: {#def-vector-derivative}
#### Vector derivative
If $f(\vb)$ is a function that takes a vector $\vb$ as input,
such as $f(\vb) = x'\vb$,
then its **vector derivative** is:

$$
\deriv{ \vb} f(\vb) =
\sbmat{
\deriv{\beta_1}f(\vb) \\
\deriv{\beta_2}f(\vb) \\
\vdots \\
\deriv{\beta_p}f(\vb)
}
$$
:::
